articles.mainIdea: How Recent Deals And Analyst Revisions Are Rewriting The Comcast CMCSA Investment Story
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Recent Deals And Analyst Revisions Are Rewriting The Comcast CMCSA Investment Story. Comcast’s fair value estimate has been trimmed slightly to about US$33.93 per share from US$34.65, with a small adjustment lower in the discount rate to roughly 7.99% from 8.05% and long term revenue growth assumptions eased to about 1.15% from 1.53%. These shifts are rooted in fresh analyst work that weighs the Versant spin, broadband competition, and media commitments against both bullish and bearish scenarios laid out in recent research.
